Ampli Car Hub collects your location to give speed-camera alerts, break reminders, crash detection and to remember where you parked, even when the app is closed or not in use (for example while Google Maps is on screen).
Your location is used only for these alerts while you drive. A notification shows whenever this is running.
Your location is kept on this unit, never sold, and never sent to us. To check the weather ahead it is sent to Open-Meteo without any name, account or id.
Ampli Car Hub uses the microphone to listen for “Hey Ampli”, even when the app is closed or not in use (for example while Google Maps is on screen), and then to hear your command.
The wake word is recognised on this unit, offline. A notification shows while it is listening.
Audio is never recorded or sent to us. After “Hey Ampli”, your command goes to your device’s own speech recognition service.
You can switch this off at any time in Settings.
Lower it if Ampli wakes up by itself; raise it if it misses “Hey Ampli”.
